All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
AbstractEntity
AbstractEntity is a abstract class implementing all the fields and methods that are common to all entities
AbstractTile
AbstractTile is a abstract class that implements the fields and methods used by all nonWall tiles
App
Main Class responsible for all other functions of the App Interface, that are not tied to the GUI, the Keystrokes or the Recorders.
AutoReplay
Autamatically replays the file using the default tick speed
BitFlipper
the BitFlipper Enemy is a custom enemy of my own design which when it touches the player it steals an item from their inventory and returns it as close as it can to where the Player picked the item up, it is capable of stealing treasures
Bug
Bug is a basic enemy that moves around the map randomly
Colour
Colour is a utility serializable object for use by the Key item and KeyDoor tile to allow colour coded keys and doors so that any key of a specific colour can unlock any dooor of a specific colour
ControlKeys
An extension of the class "KeyStrokes", which is responsible for actually controlling key events, rather than mapping and storing them.
Conveyor
Conveyor tiles are tiles that push the entity occupying them in the direction the tile is facing, while on the tile entities may only consciously move perpendicularly with the tile any other attempted concious movement will be nullified
DefaultButton
A custom "Default Button" class which allows for a Toggle Button to be created and have it be automatically assigned with an Action Listener and have it be enabled by default.
DefaultPanel
A custom "Default Panel" class which allows for a Panel to created with custom dimensions and a set background colour.
DirectionalIce
more advanced Ice tile that redirects the entity
DirectionalIce.TYPE
Enum for representing the type of DirectionalIce to create and the directions it redirects to and from
Door
door tiles are a tile that initially functions similar to a wall but once an entity attempts to enter it when its unlock requirements are satisfied it will unlock and act like an Empty tile
Empty
 
Enemy
Enemy is an abstract class that defines the common behaviour, methods, and constants used by all enemies
Entity
Basic interface that all entities in the game must implement.
Exit
 
Fire
 
FireBoots
Fire boots allow the player to walk on fire tiles without dying
Flippers
Flippers allow the player to walk in water tiles without dying

Holds the buttons that perform specific actions in relation to the game and the GUI.
GameGraphicsPane
The part of the main screen (i.e: The Graphics Pane) which displays the game.
GameInfo
Stores all information that will be reported to the user about the current game.
GameInfoPanel
A JPanel where information like the current level and the number of chips remaining is displayed.

Class responsible for containing a special part of the Panel, which contains the list of items the player has in the inventory.
GamePanel
Responsible for constructing parts of the Graphical User Interface used during gameplay.
GameState
 
GridPanel
Similar to the "Default Panel" class, but you're creating a panel arranged in a Grid-like fashion, rather than in a normal fashion.
Ice
Ice is a MovementAffecterTile that causes the occupant to continue moving in the direction is last consciously moved until no longer possible or the entity is no longer on an ice tile to prevent soft locking if an entity is stopped on ice it may conciously move in any direction
IceBoots
IceBoots allow the player to walk freely on ice disobeying the laws of ice
Instructions
Another Custom panel which holds the Instructions of the game.
